SELECT  
CLM.CLM_ID AS CLAIM_ID,
DATE(RES.CRS_ADD_TS)	AS "Encounter MAO002 Response Date",
EMT.M002E_ERROR_CD		AS "Encounter MAO002 Error Code" ,
BMSG.EEM_DESC			AS "Encounter MAO002 Error",
CASE
	WHEN UPPER(MST.TCL_TYPE_DESC) LIKE 'ACCEPTED%' THEN 'Accepted'
	ELSE EMT.M002E_ENC_STATUS	
END 					AS "Encounter MAO002 Status"

FROM 		HS.CLM_CLAIM			AS CLM
JOIN        HS.CDT_CLM_DT       	AS CDT ON CLM.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
LEFT JOIN	HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT		AS RES ON CLM.CLM_ID = RES.CRS_CLM_ID AND RES.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND RES.CRS_TYPE IN ('096','097','098','060','061','062') AND RES.CRS_USER_ID = 'EDIMA002'
LEFT JOIN   HS.M002E_EMT_MAO002_ERR AS EMT ON RES.CRS_CLM_ID = EMT.M002E_CLM_ID AND DATE(EMT.M002E_ADD_TS) = DATE(RES.CRS_ADD_TS) AND EMT.M002E_DEL_TS IS NULL AND EMT.M002E_ERROR_CD IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN  	HS.EEM_EDI_ERROR_MSG 	AS BMSG ON EMT.M002E_ERROR_CD = BMSG.EEM_CODE AND BMSG.EEM_DEL_TS IS NULL AND BMSG.EEM_TYPE = '005' 
LEFT JOIN	HS.TCL_TYPE_CD_LOOKUP AS MST ON RES.CRS_TYPE = MST.TCL_TYPE_CODE AND MST.TCL_ID = 156

WITH UR
